theme.title: Fear the Deer
theme.subtitle: Milwaukee's first MVP Giannis run
theme.recap: The Bucks opened a new arena, raced through the East under Mike Budenholzer, and discovered the strength of the Raptors in May.

questions.prompt: How many consecutive games did Milwaukee win to open 2018–19?
questions.context: Milwaukee Bucks · start of Giannis's first MVP season
questions.note: Seven in a row before their first defeat.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: The Bucks opened the season with seven straight wins

funFacts.text: The Bucks' season-opening victory was a one-point road win over Charlotte.
Milwaukee's first loss came on the road against Boston in early November.
That opening run marked the club's fastest start since its early-1970s title-contending era.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the first time they started a season 7–0 since 1971–72

questions.prompt: What was Giannis Antetokounmpo's regular-season rebounding average in 2018–19?

questions.note: 12.5 rebounds per game, while dominating both ends.

funFacts.text: Giannis scored 27.7 points and dished out 5.9 assists per game that season.
He won his first NBA MVP award after Milwaukee led the Eastern Conference.

source.quote: Giannis Antetokounmpo was named league MVP after this season

questions.prompt: How many points did Brook Lopez score in Milwaukee's Eastern finals Game 1 against Toronto?
questions.context: Milwaukee Bucks vs Toronto Raptors · Eastern finals opener
questions.note: 29 points to help Milwaukee take the series opener.

funFacts.text: Lopez signed with Milwaukee in free agency after spending the preceding season with the Lakers.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)

funFacts.text: He averaged 2.2 blocks per game in the regular season while stretching the floor.
Milwaukee won both of its opening games against Toronto, but the Raptors came back to take the series.
